item.description: Dulwich Picture Gallery show to feature British artist’s work hung next to paintings by Dutch and Flemish greats The contemporary UK artist David Shrigley will apply his trademark arch humour and distinctive artistic practice “in dialogue” with old masters of Dutch and Flemish painting in a major new solo exhibition in London. item.title: In 1993, an art historian found a forgotten painting; 33 years later, its female creator was rediscovered
item.description: A remarkable find by an art historian in 1993 ignited a relentless pursuit to recover the lost masterpieces of Michaelina Wautier. This accomplished 17th-century painter's works had long been misattributed to men throughout history. The pivotal recovery of her 'The Five Senses' series in 2020 heralded a new era, culminating in a landmark exhibition at London's Royal Academy in 2026, finally restoring her rightful legacy after centuries in the shadows. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
